bigquery.datasets.get: To list datasets in the project.
To get the metadata of each dataset.
bigquery.jobs.create: To create jobs for running queries for backup and refresh.
bigquery.jobs.get: To get the state of running jobs.
bigquery.propertyGraphs.get: To get definition of each graph.
bigquery.propertyGraphs.list: To list graphs in each dataset.
bigquery.routines.get: To get definition of each routine.
bigquery.routines.list: To list routines in each dataset.
bigquery.rowAccessPolicies.getFilteredDa: To get the rows a row access policy filters out, so a backup captures the full table.
bigquery.rowAccessPolicies.getIamPolicy: To get the IAM policy of each row access policy, so the backup captures who it grants access to.
bigquery.rowAccessPolicies.list: To list row access policies on each table.
bigquery.rowAccessPolicies.overrideTimeT: To access rows a row access policy withholds from time travel reads, so an incremental backup sees the full table history.
bigquery.tables.create: To create the Rubrik-managed table snapshot a backup writes through.
bigquery.tables.createSnapshot: To create a snapshot of each table, giving the backup a consistent view of its data.
bigquery.tables.delete: To delete the Rubrik-managed table snapshot once a backup finishes with them.
bigquery.tables.deleteSnapshot: To delete each Rubrik-managed table snapshot once its data is backed up.
bigquery.tables.export: To export data of each table to backup location.
bigquery.tables.get: To get metadata of each table.
bigquery.tables.getData: To get data of each table.
bigquery.tables.list: To list tables in each dataset.
bigquery.tables.updateData: To write data into the Rubrik-managed table snapshot a backup reads from.
resourcemanager.projects.get: To get metadata of the project being protected.
